name: jalase
description: Open-source AI meeting notebook: record, transcribe, and turn conversations into decisions and actions.
author: Jalase contributors

scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build --workspace=@jalase/shared && npm run start --workspace=@jalase/mobile
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace=@jalase/shared && npm run web --workspace=@jalase/mobile
scripts.dev:extension: npm run build --workspace=@jalase/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@jalase/extension
scripts.build:extension: npm run build --workspace=@jalase/shared && npm run build --workspace=@jalase/extension
